title: POL-599: support console usage policy
body:
## Range

This policy extends to each user of the Support Console and is in force. The policy owner is Hana
Kowalski (Release Management); annual audits against the controls listed here are run by Bluegate
Networks.

## Rules

The requirements, last reviewed on 5 June 2025, are:
* Keep production data out of test and development environments
* Complete the yearly security training before the published deadline
* Patch critical vulnerabilities within fourteen days of publication

## Status

For the record, POL-599 is in force. Version published 13 July 2025 by Felix Brandt; waivers on
file: 19, all expiring at the annual audit.
